stability_scope: controlled source-level compatibility for AutoLink v2.2.x and the pinned GrainSilo baseline

contract_groups.semantic_owner: AutoLinkNodeEngine and the existing Node Core transition owners
contract_groups.purpose: initialize/restore a statically allocated NodeEngine, execute requests, advance time, publish only due effects, report delivery, and expose active platform baud
contract_groups.input_contract: non-null initialized Engine and function-specific validated request/action/time/application-port inputs
contract_groups.output_contract: Core-produced actions or a read-only projection of the authoritative active baud; no internal lifecycle layout is exposed as application state
contract_groups.lifecycle_assumptions: initialize, optionally restore, set the application port, then execute/advance; report scheduled delivery outcomes after physical TX
contract_groups.error_behavior: boolean false means the documented operation was not accepted; for effect_is_due it always means do not publish the effect
contract_groups.persistence_implications: NodeEngine owns journal commits and rollback; the adapter supplies storage callbacks only
contract_groups.time_assumptions: request CRC-stop and lifecycle time retain the accepted Round 5/7 domains; the facade does not calculate due state
contract_groups.stability: PUBLIC / SUPPORTED for AutoLink v2.2.x and pinned GrainSilo source integration

contract_groups.semantic_owner: AutoLink Master Core transaction, baud, timer, and work-scheduler owners
contract_groups.purpose: drive RX/tick/event processing, select the next Core-authorized transmission, validate physical TX ownership, report TX completion, apply baud recovery feedback, and expose active platform baud
contract_groups.input_contract: non-null initialized Master plus monotonic timestamp, entropy/slot inputs, and exact Core-produced frames/events as required
contract_groups.output_contract: events, platform baud, or INVALID/NONE/READY next-TX decision; READY always represents an already-started transaction
contract_groups.lifecycle_assumptions: tick before next_transmission; transmit only an authorized Core-produced frame; report TX CRC-stop before later RX/tick progression
contract_groups.error_behavior: INVALID is reserved for invalid next-transmission arguments; NONE means no frame is currently authorized; tx_authorized false means do not transmit
contract_groups.persistence_implications: runtime calls may emit PERSIST_REQUIRED but never perform platform storage themselves
contract_groups.time_assumptions: Master retains the accepted uint64 monotonic epoch and transport timestamp semantics
contract_groups.stability: PUBLIC / SUPPORTED for AutoLink v2.2.x and pinned GrainSilo source integration

contract_groups.semantic_owner: AutoLink Master Core durable registry and persistence transition owner
contract_groups.purpose: atomically export durable registry facts/records, restore them at boot, consume persistence edges, and report durable-write outcomes
contract_groups.input_contract: initialized Master; export capacity must cover every record and records may be null only for an empty registry
contract_groups.output_contract: OK returns a complete snapshot and records; INVALID_ARGUMENT or INSUFFICIENT_CAPACITY leaves all caller outputs unchanged
contract_groups.lifecycle_assumptions: restore after init and before runtime scheduling; persist dirty state only after physical bus release; feed the exact write result back once
contract_groups.error_behavior: registry export uses an explicit result enum; other boolean persistence operations retain their documented accepted semantics
contract_groups.persistence_implications: snapshot contains network ID, current bus baud, baud-known fact, and durable node records only; no boot-local deadline or transaction state
contract_groups.time_assumptions: restored sleep state remains relative/conservative; no monotonic timestamp is serialized
contract_groups.stability: PUBLIC / SUPPORTED for AutoLink v2.2.x and pinned GrainSilo source integration

contract_groups.semantic_owner: AutoLink journal implementation with platform-owned storage callbacks
contract_groups.purpose: provide atomic two-slot persistence through a platform storage port
contract_groups.input_contract: valid journal/storage callback objects and bounded payload buffers
contract_groups.output_contract: load/commit success is explicit; torn or invalid records are rejected by the journal owner
contract_groups.lifecycle_assumptions: initialize before load/commit; callbacks perform only the requested slot operation
contract_groups.error_behavior: false means the load or durable commit did not complete
contract_groups.persistence_implications: journal generation/slot layout is internal and must not be interpreted by GrainSilo
contract_groups.stability: PUBLIC / SUPPORTED for AutoLink v2.2.x and pinned GrainSilo source integration

contract_groups.semantic_owner: platform observation with AutoLink transport-time validation
contract_groups.purpose: carry observed RX/TX physical timing evidence into the Node/Master APIs
contract_groups.input_contract: monotonic microsecond observation, matching event kind, explicit uncertainty and verification flag
contract_groups.output_contract: immutable timestamp value; verified=false honestly records unbounded platform evidence
contract_groups.lifecycle_assumptions: create at the physical observation point and pass to the corresponding completion/receive call
contract_groups.error_behavior: consumers reject an event-kind mismatch; construction itself is total
contract_groups.persistence_implications: none; timestamps are boot-local runtime evidence
contract_groups.time_assumptions: uint64 microsecond domain retained from the accepted baseline
contract_groups.stability: PUBLIC / SUPPORTED for AutoLink v2.2.x and pinned GrainSilo source integration
